pages.title: Noren Curtains
pages.text: Noren are the split curtains that hang in doorways. Four patterns exist — plain, striped, wavy and long — in all 16 wool colors.

pages.title: Plank Walls
pages.text: Plank walls come in every wood type — for the careful of purse.

pages.title: Tiles
pages.text: Tiles come in seven colors: cyan, orange, yellow, brown, blue, black and gray. Every color has stairs, slabs and wall panels.

pages.title: Paper Goods
pages.text: Two paper-made building blocks, each in a solid and a thin pane form. They let light through rather than blocking it, so a room sealed with them stays bright, and they burn as fuel.

pages.title: Lanterns
pages.text: Four paper lanterns, red and white, plain or lettered, each bright enough on its own to light a whole room. A column of them reads as a single string.

pages.title: Wrought Iron Railings
pages.text: Blackened ironwork, which lends a room some gravity.
